reviews.title: literal cash grab.
reviews.text: If you’re gonna monetize off women’s looks at least offer a free trial before making people pay. I knew this was weird when it asked me to rate the app even before I started using it. I kinda expected them to show a subscription page before I used a feature but I excepted a free trial at least. They do realize they can get better reviews and more consistent subscribers if they literally let people test their features before buying. I feel this is common marketing sense.

reviews.title: AVOID AVOID AVOID!! You will NOT get a refund!
reviews.text:
So basically I installed this app and I subscribed for the $14 plan and I got a scan after like 30 minutes so it just wasn’t functional on my phone whatsoever and I tried to contact Prettier telling them. Hey can I get a refund and they said yeah sure just go and contact Apple support and I did, twice, and both times they were rejected. I emailed Prettier again and I hey they rejected me both times can you give me a refund and they said since it goes through Apple they can’t give me a refund so I just lost basically $15 over a app that barely functions and Additionally the scan was god awful. You are better off using ChatGPT to be honest. Avoiiiiddddd!!!

UPDATE: They claimed to have reached out to me multiple times. They lied. They requested the scan voluntarily in the first email and I didn’t want to bc I deleted the app. Shady practices overall.
